# Status

Source: [wiki article 3226](../archive/3226.md); edited 2024-11-25.

<a id="wiki-3226-n1"></a>

- Statuses can be purely visual; Burning is identified as such in the introductory description.

<a id="wiki-3226-n2"></a>

- Hacked blocks abilities/ultimate but not weapon attacks; Rooted blocks self-movement but still permits aim and external movement.

<a id="wiki-3226-n3"></a>

- Invincible prevents damage while Unkillable keeps health at or above one; Phased Out permits passing through players and avoids enemy attacks.
